description: A global setup that throws a TypeError with a message of two lines (T9.15): Jest rewrites the error's message in place (`Jest: Got error running globalSetup - <path>, reason: <message>`) and rethrows the same object, so its stack, which the CLI prints, names its own class, `TypeError`, not `Error`, and holds the message's second line as part of the message, not as a stack frame. No test file runs and the exit code is 1. The black-box run captures the exit code and every stderr line that is not a stack frame.
